arguments:
{"script":"find /working -print > inventory.txt
count=0
while IFS= read -r path; do
  if [ -f "$path" ] && [ "$(basename "$path")" = "workspace" ]; then
    count=$((count+1))
  fi
done < inventory.txt
echo "$count" > workspace_count.txt
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi"}
